Log: I fell to my knees and prayed to the BitLife devs for succor.
With a heart full of <adoration/appreciation/thanksgiving/gratitude>, I got on my knees and prayed to the BitLife devs.
<circumstance-public>, I said a quick prayer to the BitLife devs, hoping to get into their good graces.
<circumstance-public>, I prayed under my breath that the BitLife devs would look favorably upon me.
I closed my eyes, spread my arms wide, and uttered a lengthy prayer to the BitLife devs.
I put my hands together and prayed for a blessing from the BitLife devs.
I begged the BitLife devs to show me favor.
I asked the BitLife devs for a favor.

Before going to sleep I prayed to the BitLife devs, saying, "This is my BitLife. There are many like it, but this one is mine. Without BitLife, I am useless. Without me, BitLife is useless. Thank you, BitLife".
I wrote and sang a song of praise to the BitLife devs so they might bless me.
<circumstance-public>, I shook my fist in the air and cursed the BitLife devs.
I called the BitLife devs a profane name.
I called the BitLife devs "money-grubbing <fools/dunces/dingbats/jackasses/pigs/suckers/toolbags/schmucks>".
<circumstance-public>, I thought about the BitLife devs and spat at the ground.

I drew a picture of the BitLife devs and <slapped it/ripped it to shreds/cut it up/set it on fire/drew a frowny face on it/threw it in the trash/put it in the garbage disposal/ran it through a shredder> while cursing them.
I drew the BitLife logo and spat on it while cursing the BitLife devs.
I cursed the ground that the BitLife devs walked on.
I wished <a piano/an anvil/a bag of cow manure/a vat of nuclear waste> would fall on top of the BitLife devs.
I wished that the BitLife devs were only ever allowed to eat <stale bread/circus peanuts/old cheese/Brussels sprouts> for the rest of their lives.
I wished the BitLife devs had to drink <lukewarm/lite/warm/hot/flat> beer for the rest of their lives.

I whipped up a Shakespearean witches' brew and cursed the BitLife devs to consume a tablespoon of <Flamin' Hot Cheeto dust/fish liver oil/sardine juice/anchovy water/plain buttermilk/wasabi/castor oil/cinnamon/sea salt/brown mustard/grated pork snout/mashed bull testicles> daily for the rest of their lives.
